components.reason: 16-pin USB 2.0-only USB-C receptacle replacing baseline USB_B_Micro J1 (PWR-001). Exposes VBUS, D+/D- (full-speed path to U1.6/U1.7, IF-004) and CC1/CC2 for the 5.1 kOhm sink pull-downs (IF-006). Top-mount horizontal part sits on the board edge (MECH-001) and has a stock KiCad footprint. Resolves the architecture's open question toward the 16-pin USB 2.0 variant since only power and FS data are needed.
verified_constraints: PWR-001: USB-C receptacle providing 5 V VBUS sink input
IF-004: D+/D- pins available for USB 2.0 full-speed pair
IF-006: CC1/CC2 pins exposed for 5.1 kOhm pull-downs
MECH-001: edge-mount receptacle compatible with fixed outline
MECH-002: through-hole shield tabs + SMT pads routable on 2 layers

components.reason: Concrete orderable module for the baseline ESP32-WROOM-32 symbol (esp32_mcu block); -32E is the current non-obsolete revision, pin-compatible with the -32. Provides 3.3 V single-rail operation (PWR-002), I2C master on GPIO21/GPIO22 (IF-001), EN pin for the RC power-on reset (IF-005) and PCB antenna requiring the >=10 mm edge keepout (MECH-001). Note: the module has no native USB peripheral; GPIO-based D+/D- connection per IF-004 is carried over as specified, but the architecture's unresolved question about a USB-UART bridge stands.
verified_constraints: PWR-002: 3.0-3.6 V single 3.3 V supply rail
PWR-003: Wi-Fi TX peak current bounded ~500 mA, within 600 mA budget
IF-001: I2C master available on GPIO21 (SDA) / GPIO22 (SCL)
IF-005: EN input suitable for 10 kOhm / 100 nF power-on RC
MECH-001: PCB antenna region requires copper keepout at board edge

components.reason: Concrete orderable part for the baseline TMP102 symbol (temperature_sensor_tmp102 block). I2C digital temperature sensor operating at 3.3 V (PWR-002), address 0x48 with ADD0 strapped to GND (IF-003), and datasheet accuracy meeting the +/-2 degC acceptance window of TEST-004 over 0-70 degC. SOT-563 package; low self-heating (<0.1 mA) supports the >=15 mm separation constraint.
verified_constraints: IF-001: I2C slave, supports 100 kHz standard mode at 3.3 V
IF-003: ADD0 = GND selects slave address 0x48
TEST-004: rated accuracy within +/-2 degC over 0-70 degC
PWR-003: supply current ~10 uA, negligible vs 600 mA budget
Constraint: low dissipation compatible with 15 mm self-heating spacing

components.reason: 1 A fixed 3.3 V LDO for the ldo_3v3_regulator block (PWR-002/PWR-003). At worst-case 4.75 V input the 1.45 V headroom exceeds the 1.2 V max dropout at full load, meeting the >=250 mV dropout-margin requirement. SOT-223 chosen over a DFN to resolve the architecture's thermal question: the tab-pin-2 output plus surrounding copper on the top layer over the bottom GND pour dissipates the ~0.85 W worst case (5.25 V - 3.3 V at 500 mA average during Wi-Fi TX) on a 2-layer board without a thermal-via-in-pad DFN. Stable with the specified 10 uF ceramic input/output capacitors per PWR-004.
verified_constraints: PWR-002: fixed 3.3 V output regulating VBUS to the +3V3 rail
PWR-003: 1 A output capability >= 600 mA continuous requirement
PWR-003: dropout <= 1.2 V at load < 1.45 V available headroom at 4.75 V in
TEST-003: +/-1.35% output tolerance inside the +/-5% rail window
Unresolved question resolved: SOT-223 with copper pour chosen over DFN

components.reason: 5.1 kOhm 1% pull-downs from CC1 and CC2 to GND so the board advertises itself as a USB-C 5 V sink (IF-006, usb_c_cc_sink_termination block). 1% tolerance keeps Rd within the USB Type-C spec window (5.1 kOhm +/-10%). 0603 size is hand-solderable and well above the 0.2 mm design rules.
verified_constraints: IF-006: 5.1 kOhm value, one per CC line
USB Type-C Rd tolerance: 1% part within +/-10% spec window
MECH-002: 0603 footprint routable at 0.2 mm min trace/clearance

components.reason: 4.7 kOhm pull-ups from SDA and SCL to the +3V3 rail (IF-002, i2c_bus_pullups block). 4.7 kOhm at 3.3 V sinks ~0.7 mA per line when driven low, well within I2C standard-mode 3 mA sink and adequate rise time for 100 kHz with two devices on a short bus (IF-001).
verified_constraints: IF-002: 4.7 kOhm value on both SDA and SCL to 3.3 V
IF-001: suitable for 100 kHz standard mode, 2-device bus
Bus low current ~0.7 mA/line within I2C 3 mA sink capability

components.reason: 10 kOhm pull-up from U1.8 EN to +3V3, forming the power-on reset RC with the 100 nF capacitor C5 (IF-005, esp32_reset_rc block); releases EN from its baseline direct tie to the +3V3 net and gives ~1 ms rise delay per Espressif hardware design guidelines.
verified_constraints: IF-005: 10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V on EN
RC time constant with 100 nF ~1 ms for supply-stable release

components.reason: 10 uF X5R 25 V ceramic bulk capacitors at the NCP1117 input (VBUS) and output (+3V3) per PWR-004 and the ldo_3v3_regulator block. 25 V rating gives generous derating margin on the 5 V VBUS node so effective capacitance under DC bias stays well above the LDO's minimum stability requirement; 0805 body keeps enough capacitance at 5 V and 3.3 V bias.
verified_constraints: PWR-004: 10 uF bulk at LDO input and output
Voltage derating: 25 V rating on 5 V max working node
LDO stability: ceramic output capacitance meets NCP1117 tantalum-equivalent ESR/capacitance recommendation (verify against datasheet stability section)

components.reason: 100 nF X7R 50 V ceramics: C3 at U1.1 and C4 at U2.1 within 5 mm of each power_in pin (PWR-004, rail_decoupling_network block), C5 from EN to GND forming the power-on reset RC with R5 (IF-005). X7R dielectric holds capacitance over temperature and bias; 0603 fits the 5 mm placement constraint.
components.reference_group: C3-C5 (100 nF decoupling and EN RC)
verified_constraints: PWR-004: 100 nF decoupling on every power_in pin (U1.1, U2.1)
IF-005: 100 nF EN-to-GND capacitor for the reset RC
0603 size allows placement within 5 mm of each pin
